messages:
mike: FYI we're scheduling a small perf microblast for 7.0.1. Change window Thu 08:00 PT. Need: short internal RN, pin command, canary cadence, and clear rollback checklist. @tara can you draft RN? @ben ops standby?

tara: Yep, I can draft. Keep it 1-line summary + 2 bullets + rollback. Exec line for #all-hands please.

ben: Ops standby. Proposed cadence: 5% (20m) -> 30% (25m) -> 100% gradual. Gates: error-rate, p95 latency, and quick QA sample check. Abort -> immediate fallback to 7.0.0 + disable kernel_v3.

sara: I'll prepare the manifest snippet and QA sample prompts.

deploybot: Running preflight for 7.0.1
```
preflight:
- infra: OK
- migrations: none
- smoke: 9/9 PASS
- canary hooks: configured
- quotas: OK
```

ben: Rollback thresholds suggestion: error-rate >= 1.5x baseline for 5m OR p95 >= 2x baseline for 5m OR QA sample failures >= 10%. On abort: pin back to 7.0.0 and flip off kernel_v3 and telemetry for the tweak.

tara: Draft RN microcopy:
```
7.0.1 (micro): batching/kernel adjustments to reduce tail latency for short prompts (~11%). No API changes. Pin: 7.0.1. Rollback: automatic fallback to 7.0.0 and disable kernel_v3 + telemetry if canary gates fail.
```

mike: Nice. Edit rollback to say "disable kernel_v3 and telemetry off". Exec summary for comms: "Performance microblast; canary-first; minimal customer exposure."

sara: Manifest snippet I'll attach: `pin_version: "7.0.1"` and a note to run `deployctl dry-run --release 62100` by 07:30 PT on rollout day.

ben: Ops runbook snippet:
```
# Pin version
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin -d '{"service":"inference","version":"7.0.1"}'
# Abort + rollback
deployctl abort --release 62100 && deployctl rollback --service inference --version 7.0.0
# Disable flag
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"kernel_v3","state":"off"}'
```

mike: Thanks all. Tara, please post the RN in this channel and tag #all-hands-announce by EOD so comms can reuse the exec line. Ben will monitor first 30m; escalate to me & tara if thresholds hit. Closing; final signoff when RN posted.
